ModalConnect.title: Connect Modal
ModalConnect.subtitle: Run GPU nodes on your own compute in a couple of minutes.
ModalConnect.story1: TongFlow runs GPU workloads in your own Modal account — your billing, your data.
ModalConnect.story2: Modal includes $30 of free compute every month.
ModalConnect.storyManaged: Your token stays yours — encrypted at rest.
ModalConnect.storyLocal: Your token never leaves this machine.
ModalConnect.step1Title: Step 1 — Grab a token from Modal
ModalConnect.signupHint: No account yet? Signing up is free.
ModalConnect.connectFailed: Couldn't save the token — please try again
ModalConnect.cardBlurb: Connect your Modal account to run GPU nodes on your own compute — $30 free every month.
ModalConnect.disconnectConfirmBody: GPU nodes will stop running until you connect again. Your Modal account itself is not affected.
ModalConnect.helpWechatPrompt: Stuck on setup? Scan to join our WeChat group — someone will walk you through it.
ModalConnect.helpDiscordPrompt: Stuck on setup? Hop into our community — happy to help.
ModalConnect.pasteHint: Paste the whole command Modal shows you — the Token ID and Secret are picked out automatically.
ModalConnect.missingId: Waiting for the Token ID (starts with ak-)
ModalConnect.verifying: Checking that this account can actually get a GPU — we deploy one throwaway test function to Modal and remove it straight away. A few seconds.
ModalConnect.verifyFixCta: Add a payment method on Modal
ModalConnect.missingSecret: Waiting for the Token Secret (starts with as-)

HfConnect.title: Connect Hugging Face
HfConnect.subtitle: Needed to download open model weights — takes a minute.
HfConnect.story1: Open models like SAM, Wan and Flux host their weights on Hugging Face; downloading them needs your access token.
HfConnect.story2: Signing up is free and a Read token is enough. A few models also ask you to accept their license on the model page.
HfConnect.storyManaged: Your token stays yours — encrypted at rest.
HfConnect.storyLocal: Your token never leaves this machine.
HfConnect.step1Title: Step 1 — Grab a token from Hugging Face
HfConnect.signupHint: No account yet? Signing up is free.
HfConnect.pasteHint: Paste your access token (starts with hf_) — any surrounding text is fine.
HfConnect.missingToken: Waiting for the token (starts with hf_)
HfConnect.connectFailed: Couldn't save the token — please try again
HfConnect.cardBlurb: Connect to auto-download weights for open models like SAM and Wan — free, a Read token is enough.
HfConnect.disconnectConfirmBody: Plugins that need Hugging Face weights won't be able to download models until you connect again.

ProviderConnect.title: Connect {provider}
ProviderConnect.subtitle: Use your own {provider} API key — usage is billed to your account.
ProviderConnect.story1: {provider} nodes call the official API with your own key, so usage is billed straight to your account.
ProviderConnect.story2: Create an API key in the {provider} console, copy it, and paste it here.
ProviderConnect.storyManaged: Your key stays yours — encrypted at rest.
ProviderConnect.storyLocal: Your key never leaves this machine.
ProviderConnect.step1Title: Step 1 — Grab an API key from {provider}
ProviderConnect.signupHint: No account yet? Sign up first.
ProviderConnect.pasteHint: Paste the API key — any surrounding text is fine.
ProviderConnect.connectFailed: Couldn't save the key — please try again
ProviderConnect.cardBlurb: Connect your {provider} account to run its nodes — pay-as-you-go on your own key.
ProviderConnect.disconnectConfirmBody: {provider} nodes will stop working until you connect again. Your {provider} account itself is not affected.

Onboarding.welcomeBody: Connect your Modal account to run image, video and audio nodes on your own compute — with $30 of free credits every month.
Onboarding.apiKeysHint: Only fill in the services you plan to use — you can always add more in Settings.
Onboarding.bannerText: Modal isn't connected yet — connect to run GPU nodes ($30 free per month)

Navigation.wechatGroupHint: Scan the QR code with WeChat to join the community group

TaskErrors.subscription_required: A TongFlow Cloud subscription is needed to run tasks — open the account menu (top right) to subscribe.
TaskErrors.modal_not_connected: Modal isn't connected yet, so nothing can run. Open Settings and hit “Connect Modal” — it takes a minute, with $30/month free compute.
TaskErrors.executor_rejected: Your compute environment rejected the task (HTTP {status}). Try re-running it; if it keeps failing, disconnect and reconnect Modal in Settings.
TaskErrors.executor_provision_failed: Couldn't deploy the executor into your Modal account — most often the token was revoked or is invalid. Reconnect Modal in Settings and try again; open Details for the raw error.
TaskErrors.task_not_found: This task no longer exists or has expired — please start it again.
TaskErrors.workflow_invalid: The workflow has no runnable data — re-save the workflow and try again.
TaskErrors.task_failed_to_start: The task couldn't start. Please try again in a moment.
TaskErrors.missing_api_key: {key} isn't set, so this plugin can't run. Paste an API key and you're set.
TaskErrors.modal_payment_required: Modal won't run GPU plugins until your account has a payment method on file. Add a card in Modal's billing settings, then re-run — the $30/month of free compute still applies. Plugins that call an external API work without it.

MissingKeyDialog.title: One API key to go
MissingKeyDialog.body: {key} isn't set yet. Create one with the button below, paste it here, save, and re-run the node.
MissingKeyDialog.saved: Saved! Re-run the node and you're good.
